message: expected `end` to close the `begin` opened at {opened}, found {found}
description: A block opened with `begin` must be closed with `end` before the enclosing construct ends. This one is still open when the module (or function) ends.
actions: Add the missing `end` where the block should close.
If blocks are nested, check that each `begin` has its own `end`; the location given is the `begin` that is left open.
